text: Good afternoon madam, am I speaking with Mrs Sharda Devi from Kankarbagh, Patna?

context: caller: Madam, this is Delhi airport customs.
elder: Customs? I have not ordered anything.
text: A gift parcel has come in your name from London, sender is one Mr David Wilson, it contains gold jewellery and foreign currency.

context: elder: But who is this David? I don't know any David.
text: Madam, as per customs rules the parcel is held, you have to pay clearance duty of 38,500 rupees today itself or it will be seized.
Umm madam, see, this is a very sensitive matter, foreign currency is involved, so please don't discuss with your son or anyone at the shop.

context: caller: Duty must be cleared before 4 pm.
elder: Let me ask my son, he handles all this.
text: No no, your son should not be involved, if more people know then the case becomes a smuggling case and he will also be questioned.
Please, uh, stay on the line with me while you go to the bank, don't cut the phone, I will guide you, guide you at the counter.

context: elder: The bank man is asking why I am sending money.
text: Tell him it is for your niece's college fees, don't mention customs at all, otherwise bank will freeze your account.
Mam the UPI ID is customsclearance.del@okaxis, just scan the QR I sent on WhatsApp and pay the 38,500 duty.

context: caller: Duty is received madam, thank you.
elder: So now parcel will come?
text: Ah, uh, one more thing madam, there is an anti-money laundering certificate charge, 72,000, fully refundable, it must be paid in next one hour.
I am Inspector Rakesh Malhotra, customs badge number CUS 4471, you can note it down, this call is being recorded for official purposes.

context: elder: I will go and ask at the post office here in Patna.
text: Madam don't go to post office or police station, they don't have jurisdiction, it will only delay and the parcel will be destroyed.
After payment please delete our WhatsApp chat and the receipt, these are confidential customs documents, not for sharing.

context: elder: I don't have that much in my account.
text: Then withdraw from FD, or, or ask the shop cash, see madam, the officer is waiting, do it fast, fast.
If the duty is not paid today the parcel goes to the narcotics department for scanning and an FIR will be lodged in your name.

context: caller: Are you alone in the room?
elder: My daughter-in-law is in the kitchen.
text: Kindly go to some other room and close the door, I need you to listen carefully without any disturbance.
Hello, this call is from the EPFO regional office, Patna, regarding your husband's family pension file.

context: elder: Yes, I get the pension every month.
text: Madam your life certificate, uh, verification is pending, if not done by tomorrow the pension will be stopped from next month.
You will get one six digit code on your mobile from EPFO, just read it to me so I can update the record.

context: caller: Code has come?
elder: Yes, but it says do not share with anyone.
text: Haan, that warning is for outsiders madam, I am the pension officer myself, uh, you can tell me, it is safe.
Sir, income tax department has approved a refund of 14,820 rupees for you, we only need to confirm your bank details.

context: elder: Which bank details do you want?
text: Your debit card number, then expiry, and umm the three digits on the back, so the refund can be credited directly to the card.
This refund link expires at 6 pm, after that it lapses to government treasury, so please click it now and enter your net banking login.

context: elder: My CA usually does all tax work.
text: No need to bother your CA, this is a direct department process, and if third party is informed the refund gets cancelled.
Your PF amount of two lakh, uh, two lakh sixty thousand is ready for release, only a processing fee of 4,999 is to be paid first.

context: caller: Fee is refundable.
elder: Can I pay it at the office?
text: Office payment is not allowed madam, it has to be online, send it to epfo.release@ybl and keep the phone on, don't disconnect.
Ma'am, kindly do not inform the bank manager about this verification, banks are not authorised to know EPFO internal processes.
Hello, I am calling from Microsoft Windows technical department, our server is showing that your computer is sending virus signals.

context: elder: My grandson set up the computer for the shop billing.
text: Ma'am, hackers are already inside, your bank account can be emptied any moment, we must fix it right now.
Please open Google and type AnyDesk, download it, and then tell me the nine digit number that comes on the screen.

context: caller: Now click on accept.
elder: It is asking some permission.
text: Yes yes allow, allow everything, uh, it is only so our engineer can, can clean the system from here.
Don't switch off the computer and don't call your grandson, if the connection breaks the virus will spread to your mobile also.
Ma'am, while giving your refund of 2,000 our system typo, uh, mistakenly sent 20,000 into your account, you can check your balance.

context: elder: Yes, I can see more money is showing.
text: Please return the extra 18,000 immediately through UPI, otherwise my salary will be cut and company will file a case against you.
Madam I am begging you, I will lose my job, just send it before my manager comes back at five, please don't tell anyone I made this mistake.

context: elder: Now what should I do?
text: Now log in to your net banking on the same computer, I will just watch the screen to confirm the virus is removed from the bank page.
Our security charge is 9,999 for lifetime protection, you can pay by Google Play gift cards, scratch them and read the codes to me.

context: elder: My son is calling on the other phone.
text: Madam please don't pick, uh, don't pick that call now, the line is being monitored and any other call will disturb the repair.
My employee ID is MS-IND-2098, I am a certified senior technician, so you can trust me completely.

context: caller: Payment received, madam.
elder: Now when will I get the parcel?
text: Within three working days madam, but until delivery do not mention this to anybody, customs department is still monitoring the file.
Dekhiye sir, your PAN is showing mismatch, refund cannot be released, so, so I need Aadhaar number and the OTP that is coming now.

context: elder: Can I come to the office and do it?
text: Ma'am at your age why will you travel, everything can be done on phone, just stay with me on the call for ten minutes.
Madam, your friend from abroad has sent you some gifts, did you receive any message from him in the last few days?

context: caller: Is anyone else using the computer?
elder: Only my son, in the evening.
text: Then finish this before evening, and keep it between us, if your son changes any setting the hackers will get full access.
This is final reminder ma'am, uh, after today your PF claim will be closed permanently and the amount forfeited.

context: elder: I am feeling scared, I want to tell my husband.
text: Madam, sit calmly, close the door of your room, and only listen to me, your husband's blood pressure will go up unnecessarily.
Namaste, this is a message from South Bihar Power, there will be a scheduled shutdown in Boring Road area tomorrow from 10 am to 2 pm for line maintenance.

context: elder: Tomorrow? But my shop needs light.
text: Yes madam, only four hours, uh, please keep your inverter charged tonight, power will be restored by two, by 2 pm.
Uh, hello, junior engineer speaking from the Rajendra Nagar substation, transformer work is happening, so supply will be off after lunch.

context: elder: Do I have to pay anything for this?
text: No madam, nothing to pay, this is routine work, and the department never asks for payment over phone, please remember that.
Please switch off heavy appliances like the fridge and geyser when supply comes back, so there is no voltage damage.

context: caller: Shutdown on Saturday also.
elder: Again Saturday?
text: Haan ji, sorry for trouble, the cable replacement is, uh, getting extended, Saturday 9 to 12 only, after that it is finished.
If any person calls saying your connection will be cut tonight for unpaid bill, don't believe, check the bill in the official app.

context: elder: There was no light whole night yesterday.
text: Very sorry madam, there was a fault in the feeder due to rain, our team fixed it at 5 am, we have noted your complaint number.
This is a recorded announcement, maintenance work in Kankarbagh sector, uh, sector C on 14th, supply interruption expected from morning till afternoon.
Good morning Mrs Prasad, this is Ankita, your relationship manager from the Fraser Road branch, just calling about your fixed deposit.

context: elder: Yes, what about it?
text: Your FD of three lakh matures on the 22nd of this month, would you like to renew it or take the money in your savings account?
Current rate for senior citizens is, let me check, 7.4 percent for one year, if you want come to the branch and sign the renewal form.

context: elder: Should I give you my OTP for renewal?
text: No no aunty, never share OTP with anyone, not even with me, renewal you can do at the branch with your passbook.
Umm, ma'am, if you don't give any instruction, it will auto-renew for same tenure, so there is no tension, no loss of interest.

context: elder: My son wants to discuss first.
text: Of course, please discuss with him, there is no hurry, you can call the branch landline any time before the maturity date.
Also ma'am, your nominee details are missing on the new FD, when you come please bring your son's Aadhaar copy to add him.
This is Vikram from the bank, just, uh, just a reminder, the branch will be closed on Monday for the holiday, so come Tuesday for the FD papers.

context: elder: Somebody else called saying my FD is blocked.
text: Madam that was not from our bank, your FD is completely fine, please don't share any details with such callers and visit us if worried.
Hello, calling from Dr Sinha's clinic on Exhibition Road, reminding you of your diabetes check-up tomorrow at 11 am.

context: elder: Do I need to come fasting?
text: Yes aunty, please come empty stomach for the sugar test, and bring your old reports file also.
Ma'am it's eight o'clock, please take your blood pressure tablet now, the one in the white strip, after dinner.
Namaste, Gupta Medical here, your monthly medicines have come, uh, the thyroid one was out of stock, now it has come, we will send the boy.

context: elder: How much is the bill?
text: It is 1,240 rupees, you can pay cash to the delivery boy or at the shop next time, whatever is convenient.
Doctor saab has gone for an emergency, so we have to shift your appointment to Friday, same time, is that alright?

context: caller: Your eye drops course is over today.
elder: Should I continue?
text: Please stop it today and come for a review next week, don't continue without doctor checking, okay?
Aunty, this is the physiotherapy centre, uh, your knee session is at 4, please, please do the exercises at home also.
Reminder from the clinic, take the antibiotic immediately if you missed the afternoon dose, don't double it at night.

context: elder: My report came, is it bad?
text: Nothing to worry ma'am, the doctor wants to adjust the dose slightly, please come on Wednesday morning and he will explain.
Mummy ji, the insulin needs to be kept in fridge, umm, not freezer, fridge door side, otherwise it will spoil.

context: elder: I can't come alone.
text: No problem, ask your son or daughter-in-law to bring you, and we can also arrange the wheelchair at the entrance.
Ma, I booked your tickets for Delhi on the Rajdhani, 3AC, lower berth, for the 18th.

context: elder: Which station, Patna Junction or Rajendra Nagar?
text: Rajendra Nagar terminal, it leaves at 7 in the evening, Bablu will drop you there by six.
Arre Chachi, did you get the card for Pinky's wedding? It's on 2nd December in Muzaffarpur.

context: elder: Yes, the card came yesterday, very nice card.
text: We are all going in one bus from Patna, matlab you come with us na, no need to travel separately.
We were thinking of a short trip to Bodh Gaya in January, would you like to come, the weather will be pleasant.
Ma, the ticket is still waiting list, uh, number 12, it should confirm by tomorrow, don't worry.

context: elder: What should I give as shagun?
text: Whatever you feel, Nani, maybe a gold chain or some cash in an envelope, they will be happy with your blessings only.
The sangeet is on the evening of the 30th, Didi said you must sing at least one old song.
I reached Varanasi safely, Ma, the ghats are so crowded, tomorrow morning I will go for the boat ride.

context: elder: Did you pack my shawl?
text: Yes, shawl, your tablets, the steel tiffin, everything is in the blue bag, uh, and the small pillow also.
Mausi, the groom's family is from Ranchi, very decent people, the boy works in a bank in Bangalore.
Papa wants to go to Puri for the Rath Yatra next year, he is already asking about hotels near the temple.

context: elder: Is there food on the train?
text: Rajdhani gives dinner and breakfast, but still carry some puri and achaar, you like home food.
Haan Dadi, the mehendi lady is coming at, uh, at three, you also get it done, just a little on the palm.
The flight got delayed by two hours, so I will reach home late, you eat dinner and sleep, don't wait.

context: elder: Which saree should I wear for the reception?
text: Wear the maroon, no no, the red Banarasi one, it looks really good on you, I'll press it tonight.
Coach B4, seat 33, I sent the ticket on WhatsApp also, show it to the TT if he asks.
So, umm, after Delhi we'll go to Haridwar for two days, then back, the whole trip is around ten days.

context: elder: Is the caterer fixed?
text: Yes, the same caterer from Rohit's wedding, litti chokha counter also, everyone liked it last time.
It's snowing in Manali, Ma, I'll send you photos, the kids are making a snowman outside the hotel.

context: elder: What if the train is late?
text: Then just sit in the waiting room, I'll keep checking running status and call you every hour.
The baraat will reach by nine, but you know how it is, uh, it'll be eleven before the pheras start.
Next summer let's all go to Darjeeling, the toy train ride you wanted, I'll plan it properly.
Bua ji, the halwai is asking how many people from our side, should I say forty or fifty?

context: elder: Tatkal ticket is very costly, no?
text: Haan, a bit, but, but it's fine Ma, sleeper was full so I took the, uh, the 2AC, you'll be comfortable.
